questions.stem: The man ____ lives next door is a doctor.
questions.explain: 先行词 the man 指人，在从句中作主语（lives 的主语），用 who（也可用 that）；whom 只能作宾语。
questions.verify: 本单元按“定语从句”编写，教材各单元的语法项目未核实；请对照教材目录核对。

questions.stem: This is the house ____ windows face the sea.
questions.explain: whose 在从句中作定语，表示“……的”：whose windows = the windows of the house。

questions.kp: 非限制性定语从句：which 指代整句
questions.stem: He failed the exam, ____ made his parents very disappointed.
questions.explain: which 引导非限制性定语从句，可以指代前面整个句子（他考试不及格这件事）。that 不能引导非限制性定语从句；“it”会造成两个句子只用逗号连接。

questions.kp: 关系代词与关系副词的选择
questions.stem: Is this the factory ____ you visited last year?
questions.explain: 先看先行词在从句中作什么成分：visit 是及物动词，缺宾语，所以用关系代词 which（或 that），不能用作状语的 where。

questions.stem: I'll never forget the village ____ I spent my childhood.
questions.explain: 从句 I spent my childhood 成分完整，先行词 the village 在从句中作地点状语，用 where（= in which）。

questions.stem: The pen ____ he wrote the letter was a gift from his father.
questions.explain: 还原到从句：he wrote the letter with the pen（用钢笔写），所以用 with which。介词后面不能用 that。

questions.kp: 代词 / 数词 + of + whom
questions.stem: There are 40 students in our class, most of ____ come from the countryside.
questions.explain: most of whom 引导非限制性定语从句，指代 students（人），介词 of 后用 whom。“them”会让两个句子只用逗号连接。

questions.kp: 先行词 reason 后的关系词
questions.stem: The reason ____ he gave for being late was not true.
questions.explain: 先行词是 reason 不一定用 why：这里 reason 在从句中作 gave 的宾语，要用关系代词 that 或 which。比较：the reason why he was late（作原因状语）。
